title: Sponsor
description: One paid advertising placement. Ads are DATA here, not code: a sponsor passes the same validation as every other record, so a malformed URL or an expired flight cannot render. See docs/ADVERTISING.md for why there is no third-party ad script anywhere on this site.

slot.description: Where it renders. jurisdiction requires a jurisdiction code.

jurisdiction.description: Required when slot is jurisdiction. One sponsor per state page.

image.description: Site-relative path under /sponsors/. Creatives are DOWNLOADED AND RE-HOSTED, never hotlinked: a hotlinked image is a third-party request that can be swapped for something else after we approved it.

policyReviewedBy.description: Who checked this against the advertising policy in docs/ADVERTISING.md, and when. Required: no ad runs without a named human having read the policy against it. Never put a claim-shark, pension-poaching, or GI Bill lead-gen advertiser on this site.
